data.narrative:
Podium Automation is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $23M to date. The valuation assessment triangulates across a comp universe of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers—three at Series B stage (Generalist AI at $2.0B, Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B, Dexterity at $1.6B), one Series A (Humanoid at $1.4B), and one Seed-stage company (Walden Robotics at $1.1B)—alongside one public comparable.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression, using total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $46M. Peer-median triangulation across the five robotics and manufacturing comparables produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. The wide gap between methods reflects both stage discount and composition heterogeneity within the peer set: the median includes Series B companies valued materially higher than Podium's current stage, while the progression method relies on raised capital as an imperfect valuation proxy.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $39M to $1.9B, with a triangulated median of $848M. Key uncertainties include Podium's commercial traction relative to peers, the appropriate stage-discount to apply to later-stage comparables, and whether the peer set's Series B median appropriately anchors Series A expectations in this sector.
